description: Show the user one whole entry of Daawid's registry, by its ID, slug or a website its owner proved control of (`domain`): what it offers with prices, whether it takes on work, hours, contact details, policies and legal details, as its owner declared them. Apps show it as a card. Not needed before a request, whose own card names the entry.

domain.description: A website its owner proved control of.

language.description: The language the user writes in: "en". The answer and its card come in it, when the entry has it.

slug.description: Its slug, the end of its address: "example-bakery".

name: get_entry
title: Get entry details
